subject.label: AI as augmentation under human governing authority
subject.description: Use an OpenAI ChatGPT-assisted workflow materially for concept development, research assistance, structure, drafting and editing while retaining human governing authority over direction, concept selection, editorial approval and publication authorization.

decision_boundary.notes: The existing UU-AAP pilot records the completed manuscript date as 2026-08-08 but does not establish an exact opening timestamp for this decision. No earlier timestamp is invented here.

actors.name: Matawaka
actors.notes: Public GitHub identity used by the existing UU-AAP pilot; legal identity is not asserted by this PoAI example.

actors.name: Усиленный Ум / OpenAI ChatGPT-assisted workflow
actors.notes: Technical participant. Recording the AI system does not assign moral or legal personhood.

intelligence_resources.label: Human governing judgment
intelligence_resources.notes: The existing UU-AAP/T manifest records accepted human responsibility in these scopes.

intelligence_resources.label: OpenAI ChatGPT-assisted Augmented Mind workflow
intelligence_resources.notes: The existing UU-AAP pilot confirms material ChatGPT-assisted use but states that exact underlying model/version continuity was not preserved for every historical session.

availability.notes: This claim is limited to governing judgment and authority scopes recorded by the existing UU-AAP pilot.

Practical use is evidenced at project level, while exact model identity and complete context history are not publicly reconstructable. `partially_available` reflects incomplete evidence across dimensions, not a claim that the workflow itself was only partially used.

consideration.summary: The human author repeatedly set direction, selected and rejected formulations, approved structure and retained final editorial and publication authority.

AI participation was material across ideation, research assistance, structural development, drafting and editing, with outputs iteratively retained, rejected, reframed or extended under human selection.

authority.notes: Mapped from UU-AAP responsibility for intent governance, concept selection, structure approval, editorial approval and publication authorization.
The AI workflow generated and transformed candidate material but is not recorded as holding final decision, approval or publication authority.

constraints.effect: Exact underlying model/version continuity cannot be responsibly reconstructed for every historical session.
Complete historical prompt and conversation logs are not public and are not required for this traceable example.
The available public provenance does not establish a discrete, evidence-backed set of material alternatives that can be safely represented as formally considered and rejected.

uncertainty.statement: Exact model/version continuity is unknown for some historical sessions.
The exact time at which the augmentation-governance decision first formed is not established by the public pilot evidence.
No formal set of alternative governance models is asserted as having been considered because the existing public evidence does not support that stronger claim.

evidence.notes: Existing UU-AAP/T machine-readable provenance record for «Вайбкодинг реальности».
Existing public explanation of accountability, AI participation, limitations and pilot status.
Iterative human–AI project conversations and revision history, inherited as an evidence category from the UU-AAP pilot.

artifact_binding.notes: This PoAI Genesis example is profile T. It does not claim PoAI/V cryptographic binding. The referenced UU-AAP pilot is also currently profile T and does not yet bind a canonical PDF/EPUB artifact.

contestability.notes: Repository Issues and the existing public discussion provide a challenge channel. No independent PoAI appeal body exists in Genesis v0.0.

outcome.notes: This example describes an authorship-governance decision rather than a future-event prediction.

versioning.change_summary: Initial PoAI Genesis v0.0 historical reconstruction example derived conservatively from the existing UU-AAP/T pilot for «Вайбкодинг реальности».
